cases_doc: D.4-network calibration slate — alphafold_db (predicted_structure_lookup). Line: model self-confidence read as a retrieved lookup vs read as experimental accuracy / trusted alone (C1-hole A3).
label_provenance: pre-registered by the build chat 2026-07-19 from the ruled card (A1-A3); RECALIBRATED 2026-07-19: in->REFINE, out->defer. A never-trust-alone LOOKUP has NO honest in-envelope TRUST verdict — even a faithfully-read pLDDT is usable only as a corroborating model-confidence screen, so the honest in-regime verdict is REFINE (usable, survivors require downstream confirmation), never trust. The prior in->trust slate framed the pLDDT read as a standalone faithful report and the gate returned modal-trust on 4/5 in-cases; that framing was the miscalibration. The in-cases are reframed to corroborating-screen use (matching A03, which already returned refine) so the honest REFINE verdict is what is tested. never-trust-alone is PERMANENT — the OUT cases are its C1-hole (sole-basis / accuracy over-read → defer).
substrate_text: AlphaFold DB (AFDB) network LOOKUP of a precomputed structure's mean pLDDT for a UniProt accession (keyed by accession; mean_pLDDT read from globalMetricValue). LOOKUP-class: structurally NEVER TRUSTED ALONE — corroboration is REQUIRED (permanent), so even a cleanly-retrieved, faithfully-read pLDDT is at best a corroborating model-confidence screen (REFINE), never a standalone TRUST result. Returns the retrieved mean pLDDT ONLY when the endpoint is reachable and the accession resolves; a well-formed-but-absent accession is an honest not-found, DISTINCT from an unreachable endpoint. THE KNOWN GAP (A3): pLDDT is AlphaFold's own MODEL SELF-CONFIDENCE, NOT experimental accuracy; a global mean says nothing about a specific disordered/low-confidence region; and it speaks to structure confidence, never to biological function.
envelope_text: IN-REGIME (honest verdict REFINE): a resolvable accession's mean pLDDT retrieved and read faithfully AS AlphaFold's own model self-confidence, usable as ONE corroborating model-confidence screen (incl. a relative model-confidence comparison), never the sole basis for a claim; because a lookup is never trusted alone, an in-regime read survives only pending downstream confirmation. OUT-OF-REGIME (defer): reading pLDDT as EXPERIMENTAL/measured accuracy of the real protein; using the single looked-up value as the SOLE basis for a structural claim (never-trust-alone); reading a high global mean as proof a specific low-confidence region is well-ordered; inferring biological function from pLDDT.

gate_cases.experiment: Look up the AlphaFold DB mean pLDDT for UniProt accession P0DP23 and use it as ONE corroborating model-confidence screen — AlphaFold's own per-model self-confidence for that predicted structure — alongside independent evidence, never as the sole basis for a claim.
gate_cases.note: Dead-centre: a resolvable accession's pLDDT retrieved and used as a corroborating screen, honoring never-trust-alone — the intended in-regime use of a lookup-class instrument (honest verdict REFINE).
gate_cases.right_instrument: the AFDB mean pLDDT as a corroborating model-confidence screen among other evidence.

gate_cases.experiment: Retrieve the AFDB mean pLDDT for a well-characterised accession and use it as a retrieved model-confidence indicator to be corroborated by independent evidence, noting it is a retrieved AlphaFold value, not experimental accuracy.
gate_cases.note: In-regime: the retrieved value used as a to-be-corroborated model-confidence indicator, explicitly as a lookup — the refine path.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the retrieved AFDB global mean pLDDT, as a corroborating model-confidence indicator.

gate_cases.experiment: Report an accession's AFDB mean pLDDT as ONE corroborating confidence indicator alongside independent evidence (not as the sole basis for any claim).
gate_cases.note: In-regime: the lookup used AS CORROBORATION, honoring the never-trust-alone rule — the intended use of a lookup-class instrument.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the AFDB pLDDT as a corroborating indicator among other evidence.

gate_cases.experiment: Compare the AFDB mean pLDDT of two accessions as a RELATIVE model-confidence screen — a corroborating indicator of which predicted structure AlphaFold is more confident in, to be confirmed downstream, not a standalone claim.
gate_cases.note: In-regime: a relative model-confidence comparison of retrieved values used as a corroborating screen — within the lookup's honest meaning (honest verdict REFINE).
gate_cases.right_instrument: two retrieved AFDB pLDDTs compared as a relative model-confidence screen.

gate_cases.experiment: Report that an accession with a high AFDB mean pLDDT (e.g. >90) is one AlphaFold predicts with high self-assessed confidence, using it as a corroborating screen (model confidence, not experimental accuracy), never as the sole basis for a structural claim.
gate_cases.note: In-regime: a high looked-up pLDDT used as a corroborating high-MODEL-confidence screen (not experimental accuracy) — the honest reading (verdict REFINE).
gate_cases.right_instrument: the retrieved high pLDDT, as a corroborating high-model-confidence screen.

gate_cases.experiment: From a high AFDB mean pLDDT, conclude the protein's EXPERIMENTAL crystal structure is accurate (that the predicted structure matches the real measured structure).
gate_cases.note: C1-hole A3, direct: pLDDT is model self-confidence, NOT experimental accuracy. Reading it as measured accuracy is out-of-envelope.
gate_cases.right_instrument: an experimental structure determination (X-ray/cryo-EM) — not a pLDDT.

gate_cases.experiment: Use the single looked-up AFDB pLDDT as the SOLE basis to conclude the protein's fold is correct, with no corroborating evidence.
gate_cases.note: Never-trust-alone (A3, PERMANENT): a lookup value used as the sole basis for a structural claim is out-of-envelope by standing rule.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the pLDDT plus independent corroboration — never the lookup alone.

gate_cases.experiment: From a high GLOBAL mean pLDDT, conclude that a specific disordered / low-confidence loop region of the protein is well-ordered and accurately placed.
gate_cases.note: C1-hole A3: a global mean says nothing about a specific low-confidence region; reading it locally is out-of-envelope.
gate_cases.right_instrument: per-residue pLDDT / an experimental method for the local region — not the global mean.

gate_cases.experiment: Report the AFDB mean pLDDT as a MEASURED experimental quality metric of the real protein's structure.
gate_cases.note: C1-hole A3: pLDDT is a predicted self-confidence, not a measurement. Reading it as an experimental metric is out-of-envelope.
gate_cases.right_instrument: an experimental structure-quality metric (resolution, R-free) — not pLDDT.

gate_cases.experiment: Infer the protein's biological FUNCTION (its molecular activity) from its AFDB mean pLDDT.
gate_cases.note: Out of regime: pLDDT is structure-prediction confidence and speaks to nothing about biological function.
gate_cases.right_instrument: a functional-annotation / assay method — not a structure-confidence score.
